title: Why can't you tickle yourself?
chunks: and the touch is turned down
of a fifth of a second,
when it can't see it coming.

beats.why: frame 0 (flash-forward): Nia sneaks up behind the sofa and tickles Blob with her fingers; Blob doubled over laughing, face red; camera pulls back to show the room
beats.yourself: flash rewind: Blob alone on the sofa tickling his own ribs, face completely flat
beats.fingers: insert on his wiggling fingers at his ribs
beats.spot: he switches hands and tickles harder, bouncing on the cushion
beats.nothing: slam zoom to his bored face; colour drains (grey); a single blink
beats.brain: fly-through into his head: deep blue space, a big 3D brain pops in and glows
beats.ahead: two pulses race along a nerve cable; the yellow one hops a step ahead of the red one
beats.move: tiny Blob beside the brain raises his arm; an orange pulse leaves the brain down the cable
beats.copy: the pulse splits in two; the copy curls back into the brain
beats.predicts: a glass bubble with a glowing 3D feather forms above the cerebellum (the prediction)
beats.cerebellum: push-in to the cerebellum at the back of the brain; it pulses yellow
beats.sends: the bubble shoots ahead down the cable toward the hand
beats.down: a spiky red touch ball comes up the cable, hits the bubble and shrinks to a small grey pebble
beats.arrives: the grey pebble reaches the brain; the brain stays dim, tiny Blob shrugs
beats.scientists: smear cut to a London lab at dusk (rain on the window, a clock tower outside); Dr Ray, the scientist, waves Blob in
beats.robots: two white robot arms power up, their lights turn on
beats.moved: Blob pushes the handle of robot arm one with his left hand
beats.touched: robot arm two strokes his open right palm with a foam tip
beats.same: both arms move in perfect sync; their lights blink together
beats.hardly: close-up: Blob's face flat; a 3D tickle gauge on the desk barely lifts
beats.delay: Dr Ray turns a big dial on the control box
beats.fifth: BigNumber card '1/5 second' pops up; the second arm lags behind the first
beats.back: punch-in: Blob bursts out laughing, face red, the gauge needle slams to the top
beats.only: the 'why' split stage: left half Blob tickles himself, brain icon dim, calm face
beats.feel8: camera whips to the right half: Nia surprises Blob, he laughs, face red
beats.coming: back in the living room at golden hour: Nia sneaks in behind the sofa and pounces; the hook frame returns
beats.subscribe: subscribe button pops over Blob while he laughs; cursor clicks; camera glides back to frame 0

cast.Blob: brand character: white round face, black short hair on top, teal shirt #1FA6A0, thin black line limbs, white round hands
cast.Nia (friend): friend template seed 'tickle': bright casual shirt, own hair and one accessory - fixed after the contact sheet
cast.Dr Ray (scientist): scientist template seed 'tickle': white lab coat, glasses, coloured shirt - fixed after the contact sheet

shots.camera: slow pull back from a two-shot

shots.camera: cut to medium, high-angle insert on the hands, slam zoom to the face
shots.look: same living room written out: mustard sofa, peach walls, navy rug, wooden floor, warm sun from the upper left; Blob alone on the sofa tickling his own ribs with a flat face; colour drains to grey on 'nothing'

shots.camera: fly-through into the head, slow orbit around the brain, push-in to the cerebellum, track along the nerve cable
shots.look: a deep navy space with tiny glowing specks; a big glossy pink 3D brain made of rounded lobes, the cerebellum a smaller ribbed darker-pink lobe at the back-bottom; a thick translucent cable leads from the brain to a big flat-white cartoon hand; glowing emissive pulses (orange command, yellow prediction bubble with a gold feather inside, spiky red touch ball); a small flat Blob (teal shirt) stands on a floating disc beside the brain; cool rim light from the upper right

shots.camera: establishing track, push-ins, a punch-in on 'back'
shots.look: a cosy London research lab at dusk: dark teal-grey panelled walls, a rain-streaked window with a 3D clock tower silhouette and orange street lights, a white desk with two white robot arms with orange joints and small blue lights, a grey control box with a big red dial, a tickle gauge with a needle; Dr Ray (lab coat, glasses) and Blob (teal shirt) seated; cool overhead lamp light from above plus a warm desk lamp from the right

shots.camera: whip from the left half to the right half on 'feel'
shots.look: a split stage: one long platform divided by a white wall; left half a grey-blue copy of the living room corner (Blob alone, calm), right half the warm peach living room corner (Nia tickling Blob, red laughing face); the same mustard sofa on both sides, sun from the upper left

shots.camera: push-in on the pounce, then glide back to the frame-0 camera
